input_count_adjudication.explanation: All ten independently identified candidates are proved source defects and are corrected transparently in the Indonesian derivative. Candidates 03 and 04 each group several occurrences of one underlying defect into one correction-ledger row.

method: Inspect each candidate in the complete frozen authority context without mutating the authority.
Check every disputed identifier, ambient space, approximant, inequality, outer-measure expression, subpart citation and bound variable against its in-unit declarations and proof obligations.
Confirm that the current Indonesian derivative makes only the proved correction and otherwise preserves the surrounding mathematical claim.
Bind all mathematical source-to-target changes to the exact occurrence-scoped ordinals and normalized hashes already replayed by the passing unit QA.
Record grouped occurrences in one ledger row only when they instantiate one shared source defect; do not create duplicate correction IDs.

corrections.finding: The final character in 'measurea' is a typographical intrusion in ordinary prose.
corrections.target_action: Remove the stray character while translating the sentence.

corrections.finding: The current subpart defines H, whereas E_1 belongs to the preceding subpart and cannot justify the displayed completion value.
corrections.target_action: Use H in the value of the restricted Borel measure.

corrections.finding: Sigma is already the domain of nu. Rebinding it to the auxiliary complement-closed family makes the closure argument circular.
corrections.target_action: Introduce the fresh auxiliary family Cal C, use it through part (d) and the opening of part (e), then retain Sigma for the original measure domain.

corrections.finding: Three statements drop the fixed arbitrary dimension r and refer only to the real line, which does not prove the theorem on Euclidean r-space.
corrections.target_action: Restore Euclidean r-space at all three occurrences.

corrections.finding: The proof defines K_k and their union H but never defines an indexed family H_k.
corrections.target_action: Use the compact approximant K_k in the estimate.

corrections.finding: The invoked union and intersection closure claims are parts (c-iii) and (c-iv), not parts (a-iii) and (a-iv).
The family Phi_aqq' is defined by a strict pointwise lower bound; the printed weak bound does not imply the asserted membership.
corrections.target_action: Use the strict inequality supplied by continuity near x.

corrections.finding: The preposition 'of' is duplicated across a line break.
corrections.target_action: Remove the duplicate while translating the exercise.

corrections.finding: The exercise quantifies over every subset A, for which nu(A) need not be defined, and explicitly introduces the corresponding outer measure.
corrections.target_action: State the outer-regularity formula for nu-star(A).

corrections.finding: The defining formula uses coordinate i, while the printed quantifier binds unrelated j and leaves i free.
corrections.target_action: Bind i in the coordinate definition.
